module.name: DOMAINTAINS
module.description: DOMAINTAINS activation and status module for FreePBX 16 and 17.
module.changelog: *0.3.0* Adds provider-authorised telephone numbers and automatic exact-DID inbound routes to the DOMAINTAINS Test answering destination for audible inbound-call confirmation. Conflicting administrator inbound routes fail closed. PJSIP Authentication=None uses authentication=off, Registration=None remains registration=none, and SIP authentication credentials are explicitly blank. Existing DOMAINTAINS-managed trunks are normalized in place. Outbound routing remains restricted to outbound-role trunks, and provisioned=true is persisted only after complete local verification. *0.2.0* Adds secure service activation through the DOMAINTAINS GUI and fwconsole command, with persistent local activation status.
